text: What if ChatGPT was installed in your brain?
This isn't pure sci-fi. Dozens of people already have chips in their brains, controlling computers just by thinking.
So imagine it. Every language? You speak it. Every exam? Every fact? Instantly.
You'd be the smartest person in history.
Scientists measured the speed of human thought: about ten bits per second. Slower than an old dial-up modem.
So the AI could know everything, but you'd still think it one thought at a time.
Every test? Everyone scores a hundred. Knowing things stops being special.
And if everyone asks the same AI, we might all start thinking the same thoughts.
So what would still make you special?
Not the answers. The questions you ask.
So, would you install it? Yes or no? Tell me in the comments.
